Method of Attack: Crypto-mining worm that steals plaintext AWS credentials and config files from compromised Docker and Kubernetes systems
Uses infected servers to run masscan IP port scanner to find exposed Docker APIs and Kubernetes systems
Uploads stolen AWS credentials to attacker-controlled command-and-control servers
Deploys XMRig CPU miner to mine Monero cryptocurrency on compromised systems
Attack Vector: Exploiting misconfigured Docker containers and Kubernetes systems with exposed APIs
Infection via crypto-mining worm spreading through Docker systems
